Atlanta (a city in Georgia, United States)
humpbacked, hunchbacked (having a hump on the back)
to lose one's way in broad daylight
to pass information by knocking (e.g. Morse code); to knock a rhythm
to squeal on, to rat on
to underestimate, to underrate, to undervalue
to fuck someone over (to cheat someone)
friendly fire (Weapons fire coming unintentionally from allied or friendly forces rather than from enemy forces, usually that which causes damage or casualties)
to get free, to break free, to free oneself (from), to get loose
to become empty; to become vacant
to become free, to get free time (e.g. after work)
to hide for a while, to take cover
to sit it out, to not participate
to push up (to), to move closer
to pour out, to flow out, to erupt, to gush out, to burst forth
to dismiss, to discharge, to fire
pochvennichestvo (a movement in the Russian Empire)
acceptable (capable, worthy or sure of being accepted)
program (leaflet listing information about a play, game or other activity)
control post, pass-through (checkpoint in a building)
to grind, to mill (to make smaller by breaking with a device)
standing, upright (in or into an upright position)
son of a bitch, dirty bastard
criminal, especially one who has been sentenced/imprisoned.
a leopard cannot change its spots
used in one of the common names of Acer negundo (boxelder)
